decisions.reason: The skin and hair supplement was publicly launched as new in pharmacies and fits the announced consumer health expansion, so management persists with it despite the lack of recent visible evidence.
As part of the established Trivital line with a public launch announcement, the joint supplement is central to the brand's direction and cheap to maintain, favoring continuation.
The mushroom immune supplement had only low visibility and is a niche line extension, but immune products gained relevance after 2020 and its costs are low, so management keeps it.

The valsartan contamination is attributable to an external supplier and was a temporary cause, and broadening generics remains part of the announced direction, so management likely re-sourced and keeps the product despite its distance from the core.
The OTC migraine triptan received its own page and represents a visible step into new consumer health territory consistent with the announced portfolio broadening, so management keeps it.
